verdict.rationale: Runloop is a sandbox/devbox infrastructure platform for running AI agents, not itself an agent or assistant that consumes external tools via an MCP client role; the evidence only shows Runloop exposing an MCP *server* (docs-tools/ai-tools) for others to connect to, which is the opposite axis. Plugging external MCP servers into Runloop so it 'uses their tools' is a category mismatch for this product type.
